name: 海洋朋友 2
description: 再来十六位海洋朋友：海象、独角鲸、海牛、龙虾、海鹦、寄居蟹、神仙鱼、鹦鹉螺、翻车鱼、小潜水艇、白鲸、虎鲸、海鸥与沙堡、虾、飞鱼和鹈鹕。
style: Children's coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a wide empty white margin on all sides; nothing touches the edges. Bold uniform thick black outlines, same weight everywhere. No shading, no grey, no texture, no hatching, no black fills except tiny eye dots, no text, no border frame. Every shape fully closed. One large friendly sea subject, centered, filling most of the page. Around it only a few separate closed shapes: big round bubbles, a closed seaweed leaf, a closed rock. No open lines at all: no water lines, no wave strokes, no ground lines, no sand ripples, no loose squiggles. The subject itself is split into about 16 large closed areas to color (body, belly, fins, tail, stripes or patches). Eyes are small solid black dots, smile is one short line. Nothing scary, no teeth, no sharp spikes. Very simple, cute, for a 3-year-old.
